### What is Matrix Multiplication?

Matrix multiplication is a fundamental operation in linear algebra that combines two matrices to produce a third matrix. It is often used to represent the transformation of vectors or the composition of linear transformations.

The core idea is that the product of two matrices $A$ and $B$ is defined
